summary: This is a Makefile target that opens a French Google homepage in your default browser and prints a confirmation message. It's a convenient shortcut for developers who want to quickly launch a website during their build process.

explanations.2: @sensible-browser is a command that detects and launches your system's default web browser with the given URL; the @ prefix suppresses the command itself from being printed to the terminal.
explanations.3: @echo prints the text to the terminal; the @ prefix keeps Make from echoing the echo command itself, showing only the message.
